nurse.text: Kalimera, good morning, and welcome to the Sanctuary. Or the Medical Centre, if you want to be formal, which we never are.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop your team on the bed. We treat sunburn, snakebite and the occasional case of sea urchin, which is every Wednesday.
There we go: good as new. Drink lots of water, wear a hat, and stay in the shade when you can.
The Ark is in the cool room at the back, which is the nicest room in the building.

else.text: No hurry. In this heat, hurrying is a sin.
